name: mcp-gateway
description: MCP Gateway for Gemini Spark on AWS

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:local: esbuild src/local-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/local-server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
